info.title: 民众满意度统计
info.description: 满意度评分汇总了整体状况以及税收、物价、粮食和公共服务等领域指标。请在“统计”页签查看评分，再打开相关领域了解影响满意度的政策。

rankingModal.title: President Rating
rankingModal.subtitle: Breakdown of rating score changes
rankingModal.normalEstimate: Normal estimate: satisfaction {satisfaction}, openness {openness}, {lowSectors} low sectors, and Culture bonus. Excludes counter, active crisis, or service deficit pressure.
rankingModal.currentDirectionText: low satisfaction/sectors/openness and Culture bonus reduce the multiplier, slowing decay. Sector penalties still apply.
rankingModal.crisisText: active disaster/outbreak forces multiplier 1.00, including rejected events.
rankingModal.oldSaveText: old thresholds may be read as multipliers and alter counter progress.
rankingModal.distinguishableImpactsP1: Electricity penalty of 1–3 points is written in notifications, but its application helper is not connected yet. Indirect impact via satisfaction/sectors is still possible.
rankingModal.distinguishableImpactsP2: Diplomatic reputation differs from rating. Lower satisfaction does not directly cut rating.
rankingModal.rangeNote: Score range 0–100; score ≤1 may trigger a coup. Bonuses: fulfill protest demands +10, handle disaster/outbreak +5, police response +2.

penalties.title: Automatic decay over time
penalties.detail: Counter increases each month based on multiplier. Multiple months at once can deduct multiple points.

penalties.title: Low satisfaction sectors
penalties.detail: Threshold <25 for 9 sectors: tax, prices, food, electricity, housing, public services, health, law, openness. Initial public services (11), health (12), and law (5) are already below threshold.

penalties.title: Unhandled protests
penalties.detail: Counted while protest is active, ignored, or pending; does not apply to resolved protests/riots.

penalties.title: Dispersing protests with security forces
penalties.detail: Method order: water cannon, tear gas, curfew, riot police, military. Failure triggering riots adds −5.

penalties.title: Rejecting disaster or outbreak aid
penalties.detail: Applied when aid on natural disaster or outbreak notifications is rejected/ignored.

penalties.title: Expired disaster or outbreak without handling
penalties.detail: Once when an event ends without recorded handling or rejection.
